name: El Torno (Spain)
description: Square red flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Torno (quartered with a tower, a chequy field, a cherry tree and a saltire).
history: Municipal flag of El Torno; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Torno arms — quartered with tower, chequy, cherry tree and saltire
